old: Every watt ends as heat, and heat only flows downhill. Each hop from die to outdoor air costs a few degrees, which is why warmer water is the trick: NVIDIA's newest spec feeds racks at 45 °C, so even a 35 °C afternoon can take the heat through dry coolers, without chillers.
new: Every watt ends as heat, and heat only flows downhill. Each hop from die to outdoor air costs a few degrees, which is why warmer water is the trick: NVIDIA's newest spec feeds racks at 45 °C, so even a 35 °C afternoon can take the heat through dry coolers with spray assist, without chillers.
source: Model: dry coolers alone do not hold the 35 C loop; spray assist stated. NVIDIA 45 C chiller-less claim kept.

old: Automated checks run before anything ships: Vitest unit tests (1,380 tests across 40 files, as of this writing) cover the engine, the content and the links; Playwright drives a real browser through checks named for what they look for — cycle (every scenario, scene and layer, watching for errors), views (every part framed clear of overlays), coplanar (flush surfaces that would flicker), parts (every numbered part has a pin), flights (every camera move between parts stays clear of walls and roofs) and ui (the page’s controls stay out of each other’s way, on phone and desktop alike). A quality governor adapts the 3D rendering to the device it’s running on, with Max quality, Auto quality and Battery saver settings for when you want to choose yourself.
